question: Project 19: the label-level Segmental-F1 gain of GRUctx over SF (+0.0418, 17-object LODO, 111 DEV episodes) is so far only shown across held-out OBJECTS inside 5 recording sessions. Does that gain come from a transferable predicted-parent-action context, or is it an artifact of sharing recording sessions (same rig/day, same operator, same label statistics)? Decide with leave-one-DATE-out on the 111 DEV episodes (legal now, no new data), and - only with a new grant - with the 37 sealed recordings as a true cross-session test.

scope.dataset: REASSEMBLE dev pool, 111 episodes, 5 recording dates (2025-01-09..14)
scope.input: proprioception 5ch + force/torque 2ch, causal lag-3, no vision, no test-time truth
scope.outcome: object-macro Segmental F1 gap GRUctx minus SF on held-out date
scope.grouping: leave-one-date-out, GRUctx/SF refit on the other 4 dates
scope.reference: SF (single-frame LR 72->9, no context), same folds, prediction-time only

probes.observable: object-macro Segmental F1 gap (GRUctx minus SF) on the held-out recording date, signed against 0
probes.comparison_reference: SF refit on the other 4 dates, same held-out frames, prediction-time inputs only

probes.observable: object-macro Segmental F1 gap (GRUctx minus SF) on the 37 sealed recordings, signed against 0
probes.comparison_reference: SF and GRUctx trained on all 111 DEV episodes, one inference pass over sealed frames, no sealed labels in fitting
